reviews.title: Sauna inoperable and slow to remedy. Not allowed to give less than 1 star or I would
reviews.text:
Plunge! .25 stars. There were errors with cost estimate, sales/product compatibility, delivery, and when it finally was assembled it did not heat or light properly. I have had the unit for two weeks. The tech support people have been friendly though not really listening and they admit they don’t know anything about the product they are troubleshooting beyond what is available in the manual. And even better they are saying their phone system does not allow them to make calls that don’t go straight to voicemail so there is no way of getting them on the phone. Plunge states in their phone answering service they do not take calls but one can be arranged through the app. But that call cannot be made as they are having technical problems as described above. Have you heard only outgoing  calls to everyone automatically go to voicemail  before? All the while the sales team is sending me multiple texts about purchasing a device I already have that isn’t working! After spending almost 2 full work days on this myself I finally figured out a major issue ( damaged wire) but bypassing it did not and has 
Not remedied full problem. They are busy sending a wire and connected me to an installer which is helpful thank you. (Not zero stars) this will not fix the totality of the problem. Replacement parts that were sent before today’s wire discovery in an attempt to help were predictably not helpful because they are not listening to me. And there initially were  no installation instructions included w the new parts. One of the new parts required 2 people and a complete disassembly of the unit (hours of labor allocated to me) without any confidence it would even address the issue! This might be the worst customer support I have experienced for a product in the price range of thousands of dollars! What are you doing plunge? There is an electrical problem that requires a technician which they have yet to send. Hey plunge I have paid for it. Can you please fix the problem already or admit you don’t know what to do and send somebody or arrange for a new unit and handle the assembly and removal of the defective unit. I would give you more than 1 star if you did that.

reviews.title: Abysmal quality
reviews.text: Do not buy Plunge. I own the Plunge Pod with the Evolve Pro Chiller, and it’s had two critical failures: the chiller previously went into an error state for no reason and needed a full replacement, and now the clear filter housing canister has cracked on its own — a manufacturing defect that risks leaking the entire tub since it sits right in the water line. Plunge doesn’t even sell this part directly on their site, and instead of standing behind their own product, customer service pushes you toward a third-party insurance claim (Plunge Protect/XCover) rather than just fixing a known defect. You will spend far more time fighting through claims and troubleshooting than you’ll ever spend enjoying this product. Save your money.

reviews.title: Worst customer service on earth
reviews.text: First and foremost.  The product works.  When you use it; you will become addicted.   I can’t even begin to explain how bad of support the company has.  I bought a second plunge after my first one crapped out.   They had a faulty system and my internet didn’t ping to the plunge so they voided my warranty.  After a month of emails back and forth (they won’t talk on the phone) I went to the COO and head of customer relations.   They finally got back to me.   Now I am here sitting for a week and a half trying to schedule a technician to install a new chiller (prepaid the $750 technician visit) and no timeline in sight.   The entire process has been one of the most maddening experiences of my life.   I have contemplated getting my attorney involved because the product is so good.  It is a catch 22 but don’t fall in love because once it goes out (which it will) you are in serious trouble.

reviews.title: Connectivity and Power
reviews.text: While the unit itself works well, I find two features hugely inconvenient and regrettable as both should be very easy features for plunge to fix from a technical perspective. First, there’s no on/off button. To tie the unit off entirely, you need to unplug it from the wall. If I’m not using it for 3 days due to work and other scheduling issues, it’s wasteful and noisy to have to run the motor because there’s no way to turn it off on the unit. Secondly, it only connects to WiFi on 2.4GHz. However, the vast majority of home WiFi units, including eero, run on 5GHz so while they promote WiFi connectivity, it’s not really the case. I was able to register the product by putting my home network into 2.4GHz, but as soon as the network changed back to 5, the plunge went offline. Again, this is something that the Plunge technical team needs to come up with a solution for. It’s 2026!

reviews.title: Brand new All-In Plunge
reviews.text: Brand new plunge stopped working after 1 hour. Turned on the jets for the first time and noticed water leaking under the unit. Leaked stopped on its own and everything seemed to be fine. The unit was cooling for about 1 hour then something went wrong. The app won’t update the newest firmware then the led screen seemed to “freeze up”. At some point the screen stopped working altogether. Tried a reset, but still nothing. Had an appointment with customer service, but they cancelled my call and told me to change the fuse. I did that and nothing improved. Now I can’t get ahold of anyone to try other trouble shooting solutions. Pretty frustrating to spend this kind of money and no one is available to help. Also, not a great start or sign of quality. Really hoping plunge will make this right.

reviews.title: Life Changer
reviews.text: I decided to give cold water therapy a try using my swimming pool when the water was below 58°. Within the first week I fell in love and didn’t want to start my day without the positive feeling I experienced. Once it started warming up outside, I noticed the effects weren’t the same and I missed it. Thanks to Plunge, I can experience it every day now!
